status: specification-decided — the topology decision below is ratified for review and its conformance cases are executable; no deployment, release, live-failover, or measured-availability claim is made anywhere in this document.

matrix.detection: clients lose transport; process manager observes exit
matrix.consistency: committed state intact under the single durable authority; in-flight work holds only its durable lease
matrix.rto: restart + boot: composition pin, migrations, and health gate verified before readiness
matrix.degraded_state: admission_unavailable while down; uncertain attempts remain honestly unresolved after restart
matrix.recovery: process manager restart; expire_execution_leases + re-claim resume interruptible work; uncertain effects go to owner reconcile

matrix.detection: poller observes missing or stale tracked-job state; orphan and fail thresholds
matrix.consistency: job records durable; wake events delivered through durable waiters and outbox
matrix.rto: bounded by poll cadence and fail thresholds (design constants, no wall-clock promise)
matrix.degraded_state: effect_unconfirmed: owner sees orphaned or unconfirmed, never silent completed
matrix.recovery: owner decides via digest-bound reconcile (confirmed_applied or confirmed_not_applied); rescheduling without the decision is forbidden

matrix.detection: pool and connect failures; boot health gate refuses readiness; all write paths fail
matrix.consistency: no partial availability: the deployment is down, not inconsistent; no fallback store and no degraded read mode
matrix.rpo: backup cadence (operator-managed) — the only non-zero RPO
matrix.degraded_state: durable_unavailable: full stop, admission closed, nothing claims success
matrix.recovery: restore named backup; verify schema revision and migration digest; run post-restore session retirement; boot

matrix.detection: store read or close errors; materialization failures surface as unavailable
matrix.consistency: durable metadata stays authoritative; content unavailability never rewrites records
matrix.rto: restore blob root; affected surfaces return when content returns
matrix.degraded_state: blob_unavailable on attachment and artifact surfaces; honest per-surface, no silent regeneration
matrix.recovery: operator restores the blob root from backup; materializations fail closed until then

matrix.detection: presence TTL expiry (default 300 s, clamped 30-3600 s); resolver reasons stale_observation or unpublished
matrix.consistency: enrollment and membership durable; presence is ephemeral advertisement, not durable truth
matrix.rto: a member stops being advertised live at most one TTL after its last observation
matrix.degraded_state: honest offline or unavailable presence with a stated reason; no false online
matrix.recovery: member republishes a possession-bound presence observation; membership needs no recovery

matrix.detection: outbox lease expiry; reclaim_expired returns entries to claimable state
matrix.consistency: at-least-once delivery; fence inputs bind entry, worker identity, and expected version; consumers absorb duplicates via submission receipts and event-key waits
matrix.rpo: 0 until explicit dead-letter; dead-letter is visible, never a silent drop
matrix.degraded_state: delivery_delayed until reclaimed; duplicate delivery possible by design and absorbed idempotently
matrix.recovery: redelivery on reclaim; retry and dead_letter bound the loop explicitly

matrix.consistency: restored catalog must match the current schema revision and migration digest exactly or admission stays closed
matrix.rto: operator-bounded restore time plus boot verification
matrix.degraded_state: post-restore: all sessions retired; every client re-authenticates
matrix.recovery: retire_restored_sessions refuses incompatible attestation before any connection; boot re-verifies the full catalog

promises.promise: Committed durable work survives orchestrator or executor loss and is resumed or surfaced honestly, never silently dropped.
promises.required_evidence: executable cases C-03, C-04, C-06 now; staging lease-expiry and re-claim drill against a real database before any availability claim

promises.promise: No external effect is reported applied while its outcome is uncertain; only the owner's digest-bound reconcile decision settles it.
promises.required_evidence: executable cases C-05, C-06 now; staging uncertain-attempt drill on the real dispatch path including the denial case

promises.promise: Loss of the durable authority fails closed: the deployment stops rather than degrading silently, and composition drift refuses to boot.
promises.required_evidence: executable cases C-02, C-08 now; CI boot smoke plus a staging PostgreSQL-stop drill

promises.promise: Delivery is at-least-once with fenced redelivery; duplicates are absorbable; dead-letter is explicit and visible.
promises.required_evidence: executable case C-07 now; staging outbox reclaim drill with a duplicate-consuming consumer

promises.promise: No mesh member is advertised live beyond its published observation; presence states and reasons are honest.
promises.required_evidence: executable case C-11 now; live presence-expiry observation on an enrolled device against the running backend

promises.promise: After an operator restore, the restored catalog is attested and all sessions are retired before admission reopens; clients re-authenticate.
promises.required_evidence: executable case C-09 now; full restore drill on representative data including the refusal path

cases.title: Case registry is wellformed and bound to the contract and tests
Lease and fence recovery mechanics exist
Stale execution fences cannot terminalize and reselection issues a new generation
Uncertain effects settle only by owner decision bound to the prior-result digest
Executor loss yields honest unconfirmed outcomes
Outbox redelivery is lease-based and fenced
Composition drift fails closed with named reasons
Restore requires operator attestation and refuses incompatible input before connecting
Every recovery promise carries required evidence and specified status
Failure matrix is complete and referenced
